metadata.title: Marvell and Lumentum deal: good, real, and ugly scenarios

content.text:
Investing.com -- Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) owns the platform ambition, while Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) owns scarce optical capacity.
One Theme, Two Risks
The good, real, ugly framework is clear here: Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) owns the platform ambition, while Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) owns scarce optical capacity.
Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL): Trading at $126.38, down 8.73% as of Nov 20, 10:33 AM EST || Market cap: $111.59B || Next-quarter revenue estimate: $3.15B || Daily RSI: 28.9
Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE): Trading at $482.95, down 9.75% as of Nov 20, 10:33 AM EST || Market cap: $44.10B || Next-quarter revenue estimate: $1.59B || Daily RSI: 31.5
Good Scenario
The prize: Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) successfully absorbs Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE), secures scarce laser supply, and combines DSPs, networking silicon, and optics.
Management projects more than $1B in annual run-rate synergies and first-year non-GAAP EPS accretion. The combined business could sell complete optical systems rather than separate components. Read more — Nov 2, 2026.
This works if AI data-center spending remains strong through 2028. Consensus currently projects Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) revenue of $12.07B in FY2027 and $19.63B in FY2028.
Real Scenario
The base case: the technology thesis is correct, but shareholders wait.
The transaction is all-stock, with Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) holders receiving 4.5 Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) shares. At current prices, that implies roughly $568.71 per Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) share, below the company's current deal reference value.
That makes Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) increasingly a leveraged expression of Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL). Closing is expected in the first half of 2028, leaving a long regulatory and execution window. Read more — Nov 2, 2026.
Ugly Scenario
The failure mode: AI infrastructure spending slows before the deal closes.
Then both companies face multiple compression, while Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) still carries integration and dilution risk. Lumentum Holdings Inc (LITE) also remains unprofitable on a trailing basis, despite a large accounting charge influencing its GAAP result. Read more — Nov 19, 2026.
